description: Konstera connector catalogue — the vendor adapters that implement one or more canonical capabilities from capability-catalog.json. A tenant binds exactly one connector to each capability they want their agents to call. New connectors land here as they ship; `capabilities` lists what the connector implements today.

categories.commerce: E-commerce platforms + order-management systems (Shopify, BigCommerce, NetSuite).
categories.code: Source code hosting + review (GitHub, Azure DevOps).
categories.cloud: Public-cloud control planes (Azure, AWS, Google Cloud).

connectors.name: Shopify
connectors.description: Shopify Admin API + webhooks. The canonical e-commerce reference connector for Konstera.

connectors.name: NetSuite
connectors.description: Oracle NetSuite SuiteTalk REST API. Covers orders for omnichannel / back-office retail.

connectors.name: Zendesk
connectors.description: Zendesk Support + Help Center. Serves as tickets implementer and knowledge-base source; also used as a customer-record fallback when the commerce connector lacks the customer.

connectors.name: Freshdesk
connectors.description: Freshdesk ticketing + help-desk. Used as a tickets implementer and a customer-record fallback.

connectors.name: Slack
connectors.description: Slack Web API + Events API. Threaded message handling + reaction-based acknowledgement.

connectors.name: Microsoft Teams
connectors.description: Microsoft Teams Graph API + outgoing webhooks. Replies via webhook (not natively threaded).

connectors.name: GitHub
connectors.description: GitHub REST + GraphQL APIs. Primary code-hosting connector; implements repository / pull-request / issue surfaces.

connectors.name: Azure DevOps
connectors.description: Azure DevOps Services REST API. Code hosting + PRs for enterprises using the Microsoft stack.

connectors.name: Azure
connectors.description: Azure Resource Manager + Cost Management + Service Health APIs for cross-tenant cloud observability.

connectors.name: AWS
connectors.description: AWS Cost Explorer + Health + Resource Groups APIs. Health events require Business or Enterprise support plan.

connectors.name: Google Cloud
connectors.description: Google Cloud Service Health + Asset Inventory. Cost coverage pending.

connectors.name: OneDrive
connectors.description: OneDrive for Business via Microsoft Graph. File listing + search inside a user's drive.

connectors.name: SharePoint
connectors.description: SharePoint Online via Microsoft Graph. Document libraries + site search.
